bench: Zero engine errors; 3 worlds; 25 artifacts (12 component sets with maturity, 12 random sets, 1 mature pool) all imported and hash-verified; 108 records; 132 reachability rows appended. The battery outcomes were computed by the harness from rows and consumed by the machine (meas.battery). Findings for the ledger: (1) the foothold criterion 'training best >= 0.5' on a K=2 cell is satisfied by a ONE-STREAM solution (half credit); every foothold in this experiment, baseline included, sits on the 0.5-0.56 shelf, so 'reached' on W2_K2 means 'reached the half-credit shelf', and the reachability table's classes inherit that meaning -- the row's best_train_max already exposes it, and a per-cell solve threshold (1 - eval_resolution for a FULL solve) is a policy the table should carry (KEEP_POLICY + LANDSCAPE); (2) the mature W0 sources were run with a stop rule (three generations past the first solver) and are recorded as 'treated' rows for reachability, which loses ten valid 'W0 4-bit reached by generation g' measurements -- the table should accept a stopped run as a baseline reach at its stop generation (TO_MACHINERY); (3) W1_d1 4-bit reached 3/12 at G100 (40, 77, 31): a new budget row that campaign 1 never measured.
disposition_note: SFE-01's component effect does not replicate at n=12 (components - random_segments = +0.009; 6/12 vs 5/12; baseline 6/12); the campaign-1 weak positive is retired. The mature-source probe (11/12) is exploratory and has a cheaper explanation (transported W0 sub-solution = half credit on a K=2 cell).
landscape: W2_K2 4-bit N200 G60 E16 has a HALF-CREDIT SHELF at 0.5: 47 of 108 runs ended their training best on 0.50-0.56 and none above 0.65; the plateau exit campaign 1 called 'narrow' leads to the one-stream solution, and the second stream was never solved at this budget by any arm, seeded or not. W0 4-bit N200: 10/12 sources solved (first solved 0, 12, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 27, 31, 99): COMMON by generation ~35. W1_d1 4-bit N200 G100 E16: 3/12 baseline (31, 40, 77). Seeding with a solved W0 organism's segments lands on the W2_K2 half-credit shelf in 11/12 seeds within 5-58 generations: the W0 -> W2_K2 gradient of SFE-10 is a gradient to the shelf, not to the summit.
science: The SFE-01 component claim did not survive n=12. Assay capable: baseline 6/12 footholds (first solved 13-49), consistent with the table's 7/17. PRIMARY: components - random_segments = +0.009 held-out (paired wins 5/12), footholds 6/12 vs 5/12; the machine candidate CAPABLE_NEGATIVE is accepted. The kill battery was therefore moot but is reported: shuffled 5/12 (components - shuffled = +0.03), opcode_matched 5/12 (+0.06), self_segments 6/12 (+0.02): composition without order, opcodes without operands, and the target's own generation-0 material all do what the components do, which is nothing distinguishable from random segments. Every inserted arm sits at or below baseline (0.27-0.33 vs 0.39): inserting 2-4 instructions into every generation-0 organism (gen-0 mean length 6.4 -> 8.9 instructions) costs a little at this budget, which is the genome-length effect the battery controlled by inserting the same lengths everywhere. Probes (preregistered as probes, not scored): position_front 8/12 (0.41), other_lineage 8/12 (0.39): a component's lineage identity and its insertion position do not matter. mature_source 11/12 (0.49): components cut from W0 4-bit sources that SOLVED their own cell (10/12 solved by generation 31, one at 99) seed footholds in 11 of 12 seeds. EXPLORATORY reading of the mature probe, with the cheaper explanation stated first: 8 of the 11 mature-source footholds end at held-out 0.50-0.55 and only one exceeds 0.60; a W0 solver answers ONE of W2_K2's two streams for exactly half credit, so the mature material transports a direct sub-solution, and the 0.5 foothold criterion counts it. That is direct reuse of a solved neighbour (the SFE-10 producer finding again), not evidence that 'maturity' improves search material in general. Must NOT be claimed: that components help (they do not, at n=12); that mature components make W2_K2 SOLVABLE (no arm's elite exceeded 0.65 held-out; the full two-stream solution was not reached by anyone in 108 runs).
